messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=eu-dedicated-inference (P2). Incident PD-5482. Symptoms: sudden 5xx spike + request queueing. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-5482

alex: ack — I'm on triage. tagging @maria @jordan :eyes:
maria: on it, pulling grafana now. seeing CPU and memory climb on inference nodes, queue depth rising
alex: can someone paste `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep eu-dedicated`?
opsbot: ```NAME                                 READY   STATUS      RESTARTS   AGE
inference-eu-0                         2/2     Running     1          3h
inference-eu-1                         1/2     CrashLoop   6          7m
autoscaler-eu                          1/1     Running     0          5d```
maria: inference-eu-1 shows CrashLoop with OOMKilled in runtime logs
maria: log snippet: ```2026-03-17T10:05:23Z ERROR runtime: OOMKilled while allocating 1.5G
2026-03-17T10:05:24Z WARN  restart backoff```
alex: we expected autoscaler to spin new instances; looks like scheduler couldn't place new nodes (insufficient capacity) — causing backlog
jordan: I'm the oncall lead for the next hour, I can take ownership from @alex and run the burst fallback plan
alex: handing to @jordan — what I've done: disabled canary route, flipped traffic to safe fallback config, notified CS about potential customer impact. Current snapshot: ~12% of requests returned 5xx at peak, concentrated on long-sequence requests
jordan: executing fallback rollout: `redwoodctl rollout --service eu-dedicated-inference --variant model-small --reason "autoscaler-schedule-failure"`
opsbot: rollout job started (id=7892). estimated completion ~2m
maria: watching metrics — queue depth down, error-rate dropping from 12% -> 4%
jordan: @incident-bot please add note: ownership=jordan; status=mitigating
incident-bot: Note added. PagerDuty incident PD-5482 assigned to jordan
alex: thanks — I'll spin up a follow-up ticket for autoscaler scheduling. leaving the bridge, will ping in PMs for postmortem
jordan: update: error rate stabilized <1% after ~4m, queue cleared. marking incident resolved pending follow-up investigation. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident PD-5482 resolved. Duration: 00:07:28. Customers affected: ~4% of active requests at peak. Follow-ups: ticket INFRA-3245 (Autoscaler scheduling failure), postmortem to be drafted by @alex. Links: https://redwood.example/incidents/PD-5482
